name: Mytory Importer for Tistory
author: An, Hyeong-woo

sections.description:
Mytory Importer for Tistory allows you to import your Tistory blog backup into WordPress. Tistory is a leading blog service in Korea. This plugin supports importing posts, dates, tags, categories, images, and files conveniently.
Mytory is the developer’s personal nickname. The developer uses the WordPress.org account mytory and owns https://mytory.net. This is an independently developed plugin, not an official plugin of Tistory or Kakao.
You can choose whether to import dates, tags, and categories. There is also an option to convert images to WebP format to save storage space.

WordPress does not allow uploading HWP files by default. However, since many Korean users frequently use HWP files, this plugin enables HWP file uploads by default.

Important Notes

  1. Imports posts, dates, tags, categories, and images from a Tistory backup.
  2. Does not import duplicate posts.
  3. Cannot properly handle videos or other special features.
  4. Tistory backups do not indicate whether posts are public or private. After importing, you must manually set private posts to private.
  5. Tistory backups do not include “Read More” folded content. You must manually transfer that content.
  6. If the import fails, it may be due to excessive data in the backup. Try extracting the Tistory backup and compressing it into multiple ZIP files, each containing around 100 folders, then import them separately.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mytory-importer-for-tistory directory or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools > Tistory Importer to start importing your Tistory backup file.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I import duplicate posts?
A: No, this plugin does not import duplicate posts.

Q: Can I import videos or other special features?
A: No, this plugin cannot properly handle videos or other special features.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Bundled Korean translations while WordPress.org translation approval is pending.
  • Registered the bundled translation directory for WordPress 5.0 and later.

1.1.4

  • Excluded review screenshots and local translation files from the release package.

1.1.3

  • Preserved JSON escapes and literal backslashes when saving imported posts.
  • Fixed invalid Gutenberg file blocks with Korean attachment URLs.

1.1.2

  • Used the WordPress query API for duplicate detection, including cache invalidation.
  • Kept large imports working on hosts that disable execution time configuration.
  • Preserved original image formats when the WordPress image editor cannot produce WebP.

1.1.1

  • Fixed Korean filenames and image references when importing ZIP files or extracted backups.
  • Handled posts whose content becomes empty after sanitization.
  • Fixed ZIP temporary file cleanup, WebP conversion, file links, and import error feedback.
  • Restricted HWP MIME handling to files with the expected document signature.
  • Updated compatibility and plugin directory compliance for WordPress 7.1.

1.1.0

  • Added FTP import option for environments where ZIP extraction is not possible due to server permissions.
  • Ensure compatibility with PHP 7.4

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
